quote.text: 42. I have no right to do myself an injury. Have I ever injured anyone else if I could avoid it?
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • By safeguarding your own well-being, you set an example for your children—showing them the importance of self-respect and care in order to nurture a healthy life.
    • Recognize that avoiding self-damage allows you to be fully present and supportive, ensuring that your actions benefit not only yourself but also your family.
  • Leadership
    • A leader must protect their integrity and health, for self-injury undermines the strength required to guide and inspire others.
    • Embrace the responsibility to act conscientiously; ensuring you avoid harm to yourself is a powerful reminder that effective leadership is guided by wisdom and empathy.
  • Product Management
    • Maintaining your physical and mental well-being is crucial in product management, as clarity and balance are key to making sound decisions and fostering innovation.
    • Recognize that the avoidance of self-harm promotes a healthier work ethic and environment, enabling you to lead projects with confidence and care for your team.
